findings: Exact-match retry checks grounded_result_sha256 and blocks a selected draft from inheriting a stamped no-worthy terminal. The first repair freeze, including a selected candidate, still proceeds when that hash is absent. Drifted and matching-capability mismatches raise GROUNDED_RESULT_MISMATCH.
After CLOSED, resolve_scientific_admission under a drifted capability epoch returns RETURN_EXISTING_SESSION and REPAIR_CLOSED_READBACK, not START_NEW_SESSION or RESUME_REPAIR_CONTINUATION.
Capability drift does not admit a different market epoch or a foreign session/slot. CLOSED readback does not reopen the grant. A different grounded result is refused.

The runbook tells the operator to repeat freeze and read the stored terminal. It does not ask for hand-edited hashes. After CLOSED, preflight is RETURN_EXISTING_SESSION and forge-run reads the repair receipt.
